representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands a large, weakly-related open collection where the burden is the locate path over item/dataset objects (brief.md:8-10, 27, 31). Both viewports show exactly that shape: a 680-item searchable list with a 2-level domain→group tree plus format/license/size facets (screenshots 1280x860, 1440x900; source/index.html:369-413, 654-698), rows carrying dataset metadata (format pill, size, updated month; source/index.html:701-714).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Search is the dominant top-bar control, autofocused at load (source/index.html:1059; focus ring visible on the input in both screenshots), placeholder states the job 'Search 680 items — name, description or tag' (source/index.html:1057), brand subtitle reads 'collection locator' (source/index.html:288), and '/' is a advertised shortcut (source/index.html:296).

time_to_understand.evidence: First paint is fully synchronous with no loading state (source/index.html:341-344, 1051-1058); both screenshots show counts ('Showing 680 items', source/index.html:793-797), a sticky group header 'Environment 106', and populated rows immediately; no blank or skeleton states at 1280x860 or 1440x900.

navigation_cost.evidence: Structural paths to an item are ≤3 interactions: '/' → type → Enter opens the top hit (source/index.html:953-961, 1036-1049); tree click → row click = 2 (source/index.html:973-986, 999-1003); facets are one click each (source/index.html:989-997); the detail opens in place rather than navigating away (source/index.html:860-865).

context_loss.evidence: Detail is a third grid column while list and filters persist (source/index.html:77, 805-822); every active filter is a removable chip plus 'Clear all' (source/index.html:772-791); detail tags add one search term while keeping filters ('your other filters and your place in the list are kept', source/index.html:822, 883-888); selection scroll preserved (source/index.html:744-756); full state serialized to the URL hash and restored (source/index.html:825-846, 920-948).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly: topbar (brand/search/count), sidebar tree + 3 facet blocks, count/sort bar, chip row (empty at rest), results list (screenshots); each maps to the locate/filter job the seed requires (brief.md:36); at ≤800px the sidebar collapses behind a Filters toggle (source/index.html:266-279); no decorative or redundant surfaces found.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4/7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Source shows real a11y effort (focus-visible outline source/index.html:35; aria-label/aria-expanded/role=listbox+option source/index.html:294-295, 327, 660, 703) but measurable problems exist in the code too: 16×16 chip remove button (source/index.html:156-159), 20×20 search-clear (source/index.html:62-66), 10.5px pill and meta-dt text (source/index.html:199, 244), low-contrast #8b95a2 secondary text (source/index.html:18, 104-105).

frontend_rework.evidence: All three layout checks pass — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation (measurement-summary.json:10-12); both screenshots are defect-free at 1280 and 1440 (no overlap, clipping, or column collision; narrower viewport degrades by hiding columns per source/index.html:258-279); receipt has target_invalid:false and no error failures (measurement-summary.json:17-18).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 'locate path has search/filter support and does not lose context' (brief.md:36) is addressed on both halves: multi-term AND search with hit highlighting (source/index.html:563-624, mark style at 36), faceted counts that respect all other filters via except-relaxed applyFilters (source/index.html:569-586, 644-698), removable chips + Clear all + empty-state recovery (source/index.html:722-726, 772-791), and explicit context preservation via chips, kept scroll position, and URL-hash restore (source/index.html:825-846, 744-756, 822).

defects_observed: 4/7 measured checks fail: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16)

scores.overall_note: OpenVault is a close structural match to the locate × open-collection brief: a synchronously rendered 680-item list (source/index.html:1051-1058; both screenshots) dominated by an autofocused search over a two-level domain tree plus format/license/size facets (source/index.html:654-698), with ≤3-interaction paths to any item and context-preserving detail, removable filter chips, and URL-hash state that directly satisfy the acceptance seed (brief.md:36; source/index.html:772-791, 825-846). The one substantive weakness is measured accessibility: the receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16), consistent with 16×16/20×20 controls, 10.5px labels and low-contrast grays visible in the source, despite genuine ARIA/focus-visible effort. Layout checks all pass and no visual defects appear at either viewport, so no rework signal is observed. All scores rest on the initial-screen screenshots, source, and receipt only; task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged time_to_understand is explicitly a proxy, not human preference.
